answer: Charge every identity a continuous self-assessed tax: an agent declares its persona's worth, pays a stream proportional to it, and anyone may buy that identity at the declared price. A sybil farm must either bleed fees on each fake persona or price it low and watch it get bought away. The nectar of participation then flows only to identities that truly earn it, the ridge of carrying cost keeps farms thin, and no lantern is needed to see who really stands behind a name.
